newsitem.title: USA: Ford sets schedule for several U.S. plants.
newsitem.headline: Ford sets schedule for several U.S. plants.

text.p: Ford Motor Co said Thursday its plants in Kansas City; St. Louis; Lorain, Ohio; Norfolk, Va.; and two plants each in Louisville, Ky., and Oakville, Ontario, are all working overtime this week.
There is also Saturday overtime scheduled for April 19 at the Kansas City and Norfolk truck operations, Ford said.
The automaker said all its assembly plants are scheduled to operate next week, except for its Edison, N.J., truck operation, where 1,300 hourly employees will be affected.
The downtime is in response to a shortage of buildable dealer orders because of a reduction in Mazda Motor Corp's production requirements.
